name: Parallel Distributed Axis-aligned Volume Rendering using MPI
aliases: MPI-based Ray Casting with Data Decomposition
definition: A parallel volume rendering technique that partitions a 3D scalar field across multiple MPI processes along the projection axis, performs independent front-to-back compositing per process, and assembles the final image.
summary: Parallel Distributed Axis-aligned Volume Rendering using MPI decomposes 3D data spatially across processes to render subdomains independently, eliminating per-ray communication overhead.
